error[ZBX-E0818]: a glob matched more paths than one import can hold
  while  matching a glob
  cause  "src/**/*.go" matched more paths than one import holds (65536 paths,
         4194304 bytes)
  input  src/**/*.go
  limit  65536 paths
  fix    match a directory instead of the files in it, narrow the glob, or .exclude what you do not need
  more   zbx explain E0818
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0818.html
